commandContract.sameOwner: repeat the same direct claim under the original actor
commandContract.foreign: repeat claim with BEADS_ACTOR=s1-b04-foreign and retain exit/stderr
commandContract.emptyFront: claimNext after all eligible rows are consumed returns JSON null/empty success
commandContract.dump: --readonly export --format plug-dump/1 --plug-inventory; retain real custom-status/live-claim refusal with absent archive and unchanged source; downstream NOT_RUN
commandContract.customActive: update <configured-active-id> --claim --json; assert observed hydrated output and stored postimage
commandContract.versions: --readonly versions <observed-id> --json; preserve actual rows or default history-off refusal without toggling source policy
commandContract.physical: --readonly sql SHOW TABLES / SELECT * / SHOW COLUMNS / dolt_log; complete row multisets and column schema, no-op and refusal equality

qualification: AUTHORED_NOT_RUN; fresh accepted preparation, two native stores, and Plug replay are required; no historical unit transfers credit
clockScope: native claim columns must be observed DATETIME(0); compare started_at to both actual command endpoints rounded to that same nearest-second domain, retaining raw nanosecond receipts; no lease-expiry or B05 qualification
boundaries: native source IDs are bound to actual Plug refs and never treated as identical identities
expected refusal streams are retained before assertions
ordinary B04 tests remain separate from this manual native target
no B05 heartbeat/renewal/reclaim or B22 topic work
